summary: Aduro Clean Technologies filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a non-brokered private placement (LIFE Offering) for gross proceeds of C$9.16M (US$6.56M) from the sale of 431,884 common shares at C$21.20 per share. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under Canadian prospectus exemptions, with proceeds intended for technology development, commercialization, and working capital. Insider participation is disclosed as a related party transaction. No special-situation categories apply because the filing describes an ordinary equity offering, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative event.
